title: Pre-Pilot Verification Gate (P-4)
description: Implement and execute the dedicated deterministic Pre-Pilot Verification Gate required before Item 8. The gate must prove cross-controller integration, synthetic LOW and HIGH lifecycle dry runs, negative fail-closed behavior, and complete regression without LLM execution or production mutation. Passing implementation tests alone does not authorize Item 8; canonical protected merge, exact-SHA post-merge verification, independent Review/QA disposition, and a separate canonical closure record are required before P-4 can be declared PASS.

acceptance_criteria.description: A dedicated deterministic pre-pilot harness composes only Multi-Agent control modules and performs no product-runtime, database, API, workflow, package or production mutation.
All existing Items 1-7 deterministic Multi-Agent tests pass together with the complete canonical repository regression suite.
Cross-controller integration covers Lock ↔ Workflow, Risk ↔ Project Map sensitive zones, Artifact Binding ↔ Human Gate invalidation, and Merge Policy ↔ required upstream gates.
A synthetic LOW task completes a complete deterministic lifecycle dry run without LLM execution or production mutation.
A synthetic HIGH task completes a deterministic lifecycle dry run through exact-artifact Review, Security and Project Owner Human Gate handling without LLM execution or production mutation.

Negative fail-closed coverage proves lock conflict, attempted risk downgrade, artifact mutation after approval, unauthorized gate evidence, external-head/fork rejection, spoofed required-check identity rejection, stale evidence rejection, and protection drift blocking.
Generated Task Catalog is exact for the branch, includes MA-PRE-PILOT-GATE-001, and passes deterministic docs-automation check.
Exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A Verification, Merge Policy, artifact-bound independent Review/QA PASS and ACTIVE Lock are all green with zero unresolved blocking findings before canonical merge.

P-4 remains not-PASS and Item 8 remains forbidden until this task is merged through protected main, exact-SHA post-merge verification succeeds, and a separate canonical closure synchronization records P-4 PASS.
